description: Agent Vendors: submit every place the agent can see this vendor’s price for one item: the item, and each source with its id, its kind (a quote, a listing, an invoice, a prior charge, an order, a contract or other), the amount it shows, its currency, the quantity the amount is for, when it was issued or charged, its reference and the vendor’s reason for any difference; and optionally the source to compare against (the first quote when left out), a tolerance as a percent of the price (0 when left out) and the agent’s own note on the price, read for wording that averages a difference away such as about, roughly or on average. The signed report gives the source compared against, every source with its price per unit, its difference in amount and percent and its status as compared_against, consistent, explained, unexplained, other_currency or unpriced, and counts the sources consistent, explained, unexplained, in another currency and unpriced with the lowest and highest price per unit, and names a price that is not consistent: differences with no reason from the vendor and a note that averages the differences away rather than naming each; then differences explained by the vendor, prices in another currency with no rate and sources with no price, with the fix for each. Every unexplained difference is named rather than averaged away. This reads the price this vendor quoted this buyer before the spend: one paid call’s quote against its settled charge is wever_price-truth-check, an invoice against its job or mandate is wever_invoice-check, a pricing page priced two ways is wever_pricing-evidence-check and recurring charges already running are wever_subscription-audit. Verdict price_inconsistent, price_variance_noted, price_uncompared or price_consistent. POST /api/vendor-price-consistency-check. Reads only the recorded vendor material in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write; no vendor is contacted, no quote is accepted, no order is placed and no spend is approved. Agent Vendors reads the seller on the other side of a spend before the agent commits: whether the vendor is who it claims to be, whether its quote and terms hold together, whether its price stays the same and what it costs to leave. It is not one service’s terms on their own (wever_service-terms-check reads one service’s terms by themselves; the vendor terms-match check reads a vendor’s terms against the specific quote or order in front of the agent, where a contradiction costs money), not pricing structure or fee evidence (wever_pricing-tier-check and wever_fee-evidence-check; the vendor price check reads whether the price this vendor quoted this buyer stays consistent across the quote, the listing and any invoice or prior charge), not single promise types (wever_warranty-check and wever_shipping-check; the vendor delivery and refund checks read the whole delivery promise and the whole remedy path for one vendor engagement), not listing accuracy (wever_catalog-listing-check reads whether a catalog listing is accurate; a directory or marketplace listing being present is not vendor verification, and no vendor check treats listing presence as identity evidence), not after the payment (wever_purchase-record-check and wever_double-charge-check run after a payment; the vendor checks run before the spend, while walking away is still free), not the buyer’s own permission (wever_spending-policy-check and wever_authority-scope-check read the buyer’s permission to spend; the vendor checks read the seller on the other side of the spend: permission is not diligence, and diligence is not permission), not a promise once made (the wever_commitment checks; a vendor engagement becomes a commitment only after the agent accepts it, and the vendor checks guard the moment before that) and not an objective (the wever_goal checks read the objective the work serves; a vendor check reads a counterparty, not an objective). Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-vendors-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-vendors/.

against.description: The id of the source the others are compared with; the first quote when left out.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.

note.description: The agent’s own note on the price, read for wording that averages a difference away, such as about or on average.

at.description: When it was issued or charged.

explanation.description: Why its price differs, as the vendor stated it, such as a volume discount or tax.

id.description: The source id, such as s1.

kind.description: A quote, a listing, an invoice, a prior charge, an order, a contract or other.

quantity.description: The quantity the price is for; 1 when left out.

tolerance_percent.description: A difference at or under this share of the price counts as the same price; 0 when left out.

name: wever_vendor-price-consistency-check
title: Vendor price consistency check
